question: the best FlexiCT candidates of suite 20261017_flexict_improvement lie at the smallest field (40 mm) and the earliest block (10) of that grid; this extension tests a smaller field and earlier blocks before FlexiCT enters the SAE exploration
field_rule: provider-centred physical crop, 48^3 tensor (patch 8, 6^3 tokens), spacing = field / 48 (0.67 and 0.83 mm), HU clipped to [-1000, 1000] and z-scored over the field, as in the baseline suite
layer_rule: patch tokens after block b of 16 with the final norm applied (official get_intermediate_layers)
head: max
selection: as in 20261017_flexict_improvement; the final choice per model is the higher three-seed mean AUROC of the two suites' selected candidates, and it replaces the baseline selection only if higher than the baseline
